reform: 3+2 (3 无选项 fill-input + 2 有选项 quiz-opt)
scope: 阅读 A/B/C 篇 · 每篇 5 题
contract: 契约\1_课程概要.md 词汇池(20词)/语法上限(G37 be-have, G38 why-because, G39 形容词)

questions.question: What is Miss Wang's height?
questions.required_grammar: G37 be + 形容词/介词短语描述身高（of medium height），未超上限

questions.question: What does Miss Wang wear?
questions.required_grammar: G37 wear + glasses（答名词短语即可），未超上限

questions.question: What does Miss Wang look like?
questions.canonical_answer: She is of medium height and thin.
options: She is short and has curly hair.
She is of medium height and thin.
questions.open_degree: 综合概括细节（多项特征叠加），答案边界宽 → 有选项

questions.question: Why does the writer like Miss Wang?
required_vocab: friendly（原文词，L1-13 基础形容词，可原文摘录）
questions.required_grammar: G38 because 因果（课上核心考点）

questions.question: What is the main idea of this passage?
questions.canonical_answer: Miss Wang is the writer's favorite teacher because she is kind and friendly.
options: Miss Wang is the writer's favorite teacher because she is kind and friendly.
Miss Wang is tall and heavy.
The writer wants a new teacher.

questions.question: What is Mr. Lee's hair like?
questions.required_grammar: G37 has + 名词 / be + 形容词

questions.question: What does Mr. Lee teach us to draw?
questions.required_grammar: G37 名词短语（原文可提取）

questions.question: What does the word "artist" mean in this passage?
questions.open_degree: 开放性词义判断 → 有选项

questions.question: Why do we like Mr. Lee?
questions.canonical_answer: because he is very kind and funny
accepted_answers: because he is very kind and funny
because he is kind and funny
he is very kind and funny
required_vocab: funny（原文词，L1-13 基础形容词，可原文摘录）
questions.required_grammar: G38 because 因果（课上核心考点）

questions.question: How do the students feel about Mr. Lee?
questions.canonical_answer: They are happy and like his class.
options: They are happy and like his class.
They think his class is boring.
questions.open_degree: 推断（由 We are happy / Every student likes his class 概括）→ 有选项

questions.question: Why do people look different?
questions.canonical_answer: because every person has different height, weight and hair
accepted_answers: because every person has different height, weight and hair
because every person has different height, weight, and hair
every person has different height, weight and hair
every person has different height, weight, and hair
questions.required_grammar: G38 because 因果（课上核心考点）

questions.question: Where does your height come from?
questions.required_grammar: G37 基础 be + 介词短语表来源（be from）

questions.question: How does the writer feel about people looking different?
questions.canonical_answer: He thinks it is fun and makes everyone special.
options: He thinks it is a problem.
He thinks people should look the same.
He thinks it is fun and makes everyone special.
questions.open_degree: 态度推断（由 appearance makes you special / fun to learn 概括）→ 有选项

questions.question: What is the main idea of this passage?
questions.canonical_answer: People look different because of height, weight, hair and more.
options: People look different because of height, weight, hair and more.
questions.open_degree: 主旨大意 → 有选项（原 Q016 题面保留，选项轮转）

qa_notes: 每篇 5 题 = 3 fill-input + 2 quiz-opt（3+2 默认配额，无 2+3 弹性需求）
无选项题均满足：必读文章才能答 + 本等级短答案可作答 + 合理措辞差异已入 accepted_answers
判分：忽略大小写/首尾空格/连续空格/句末标点，全串精确匹配，禁止关键词包含判分
placeholder 均为中性提示「输入答案」，无答案/同义/首字母泄漏
required_vocab 中 friendly/kind/funny/parents 等非本课新词池词均为原文词，学生可原文摘录作答（§3.18.4 允许）
语法均 ≤ G37/G38/G39，无 will/比较级/完成时/被动
